By using (<color=#00ff00>right-click</color>) a stack of ammo, you can specifically load that kind of ammo in the currently equipped weapon (if compatible). For example, by using the HCB Acid Charge ammo <i>item</i>, you can automatically swap out the HCB Mark II ammo in your Bulleteer. Swapping ammo like this costs both the unload and reload APs of the weapon--but this extra cost is factored into the AP number displayed over the ammo's item slot.\n\nWhen <color=orange>unloading</color> a weapon (including ammo swapping), the unloaded ammo will be automatically merged into the first compatible stack of ammo, or if there's none, it will appear as a new stack. If, for any reason, it doesn't fit into the inventory, the excess stack will be dropped to the ground.\n\n<color=orange>Hand grenades, mines, and deployable ordnances (turrets)</color> are all considered both weapons and ammo, thus you can keep them in any of the combat-related restricted slots."
